name: @redex/credentials
description: F6 — OB 3.0 / W3C VC issuer toolkit: the typed AchievementCredential builder, the eddsa-rdfc-2022 (Ed25519) Data Integrity signer + verifier, the BitstringStatusList revocation codec, and did:web issuer-profile helpers. Shared so M7 reuses it; the Deno issue-badge Edge Function reuses the leaf modules (contexts + multibase) by direct import and is pinned to this signer by a deterministic test vector.
